'''''Roldana''''' also known as '''[[groundsel]]''' is a [[genus]] of large herbs or sub[[shrub]]s from the  [[Senecioneae|groundsel tribe]] within the [[Asteraceae|sunflower family]].<ref>La Llave, Pablo de & Lexarza, Juan José Martinez de. 1825.  Novorum Vegetabilium Descriptiones 2: 10</ref><ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/12995396#page/68/mode/1up Turner, B. L. 2006. A recension of the Mexican species of ''Roldana'' (Asteraceae: Senecioneae). Phytologia 87(3): 204–249. ]</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40026700 Tropicos, ''Roldana'' La Llave ]</ref>

Most if not all of its members used to be members of a related genus, ''[[Senecio]]''.  The species are native to [[Southwest United States]], [[Mexico]] and [[Central America]] and some are naturalized elsewhere.<ref name="FNA">{{cite journal
  | last =Funston
  | first =A. Michele 
  | title = 230. Roldana La Llave
  | journal =[[Flora of North America]]
  | volume =20
  | pages = Page 542,'''620'''
  }}</ref><ref name="anbg">{{cite web
 | url = http://www.anbg.gov.au/abrs/abif/flora/stddisplay.xsql?pnid=5973
 | title = ''ROLDANA''
 | accessdate = 2008-05-23
 | work = Flora of Australia Online
 }}</ref>
